skill_outcomes.skill_name: Basic Concepts and Theories in Economic Geography
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts, major factors, and important theoretical approaches in economic geography.
Understand spatial organization of economic activities in different territorial levels and contemporary economy.
Understand how economic activities operate and distribute according to spatial laws.
Analyze geographic dynamics and their impact on the distribution and organization of economic activities.
Apply geographic approaches to explain the distribution of economic activities and manage territorial space effectively.
Develop self-learning, independent work, teamwork, and responsibility skills.
